blocks.text: 510 3581 ROSS DRIVE University VW Vancouver V6S 0K5

parts.t: VIRTUOSO was built by award-winning developer, ADERA in UBC's Wesbrook Village! Come check out this 2 BD + DEN inner court yard suite filled with w/nature & waterfalls for quietness and privacy. Featuring an OPEN floor plan with bedrooms on opposite sides, 10ft ceilings, Forced air heating / AC, Floor-to-ceiling windows & Kitchen Aid Appliances! The spacious living room leads you to a HUGE private patio for your year-round enjoyment! The building is located on a QUIET street close to UBC, U-Hill Secondary School, shopping, transit, eateries, recreation & steps to trails & beaches. BEST location at UBC Village!
